summary: Outbound SmartStore links now preserve Naver Shopping API link values instead of guessing canonical store slugs. This fixes product-not-found failures caused by unstable slug rewriting.
rootCause: The app rewrote /main/products/{id} links to guessed SmartStore slug URLs.
Live Naver responses show /main/products/{id} is the stable resolver and may redirect to cardkingdom, yugiohstore, or sulyunyen depending on the product.
evidence: Live provider spot check for 도마우스 returned /main/products links for CardKingdom and CardSquare
curl -I on CardKingdom /main/products link returned 307 location /cardkingdom/products/11153000742
curl -I on CardSquare /main/products link returned 307 location /yugiohstore/products/11151278987
knownLimitations: Naver SmartStore can still show login/security/429 behavior depending on the user session.
The app should not infer final SmartStore slugs unless Naver exposes a stable canonical URL in the API.
